item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":14,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that Congolese authorities targeted opposition party leaders, restricted fundamental liberties, and arrested party officials from May 2023 amid preparations for the December presidential election.","question_ids":["4B.2","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report attributes the conduct to Congolese authorities during Félix Tshisekedi's presidency and candidacy for a second term.","limitations":["Human Rights Watch's characterization is an external institutional finding; the supplied passage does not establish Tshisekedi's personal order for each action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"On 23 May 2023, police blocked opposition leader Moïse Katumbi's convoy from entering Kongo-Central for planned political meetings and rallies, following instructions from the provincial governor; authorities had also ordered him to limit the trip to one location.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The immediate order is attributed to the provincial governor; it occurred under the national authorities led by Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The passage does not show whether Tshisekedi personally authorized the governor's instruction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"On 25 May 2023, police blocked opposition candidates and supporters from holding a sit-in outside the National Independent Electoral Commission, used tear gas, and beat some demonstrators; authorities subsequently banned another opposition demonstration in Lubumbashi and blocked streets.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The actions are attributed to police and other authorities under Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["The supplied report does not establish a direct presidential order."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that police had violently repressed a peaceful opposition demonstration on 20 May 2023, arresting dozens and seriously injuring at least 30 people, including a child.","question_ids":["3B.8","3B.9","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The conduct is attributed to police under the Congolese authorities.","limitations":["The report does not identify the individual officers responsible or establish a direct presidential instruction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":16,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"On 30 May 2023, military intelligence arrested opposition leader Moïse Katumbi's adviser Salomon Kalonda at Kinshasa airport; he remained detained at military intelligence headquarters until 10 June, was transferred to military prison, and was formally charged with treason and related offenses on 14 August.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.5","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The arrest and detention are attributed to military intelligence under Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["The allegations against Kalonda and the claim of political motivation were contested or characterized as concerns in the supplied report; no final judicial finding is provided."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":16,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"After Kalonda's arrest, police searched residences belonging to him and relatives, including his 85-year-old mother's home, and military intelligence searched Katumbi's residence; the reported searches included property damage and seizure of Qur'an videotapes.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.3","4B.3"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The searches are attributed to police and military intelligence under Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["The account relies partly on a relative's testimony, and the supplied passage does not report a final investigation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":16,"end_unit":16,"fact_summary":"On 20 June 2023, Republican Guard members arrested opposition presidential candidate Franck Diongo on an allegation of illegal weapon possession; he was detained, transferred to military prison after a hearing, and released without charge on 15 July.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","4B.3"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The arrest is attributed to the Republican Guard, a unit protecting the president, under Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["Release without charge is favorable as a corrective outcome, but the supplied report does not explain why the arrest occurred or whether any officials were disciplined."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":16,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Parliamentarian and opposition spokesman Chérubin Okende was found dead with gunshot wounds in Kinshasa on 13 July 2023; the government denounced the killing, made two arrests, and announced an inquiry involving foreign services, with UN, South African, and Belgian experts reportedly assisting investigators.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The government's announced response occurred under Tshisekedi; the killing itself is not attributed to the president or state actors in the supplied passage.","limitations":["The supplied text does not provide the inquiry's final findings or establish whether the response produced accountability."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The UN Joint Human Rights Office reported in August 2023 that the pre-electoral environment was marked by narrowing civic space, political and electoral violence, arbitrary arrests and detentions, abductions, threats against opponents, excessive force against peaceful demonstrators, and hate speech and incitement to violence.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"This is an institutional finding about the national pre-electoral environment under Tshisekedi's administration.","limitations":["The finding describes the environment and does not assign personal responsibility to Tshisekedi for every listed act."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"On 25 June 2023, Tshisekedi stated in a speech that he would target without hesitation or regret Congolese people who endangered national security and stability, and said that criticism concerning human-rights violations or deprivation of freedoms would not cause him to abandon that position.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.5","3B.9","4B.3","7B.1"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement attributed directly to Félix Tshisekedi.","limitations":["The passage provides the statement but does not document a specific subsequent order or act implementing it."]},{"source_id":"SRC-80fcdff869fb93e4","start_unit":17,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Journalists in Danger reported increased intolerance and physical violence against journalists covering political events; on 29 July 2023 in Kananga, alleged ruling-party supporters threw rocks that hit at least four journalists and six cameramen, and opposition candidate Delly Sesanga was also hit.","question_ids":["3B.3","4B.3","4B.6"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The attackers were described as alleged ruling-party supporters; the supplied passage does not establish that Tshisekedi directed the attack.","limitations":["The report does not state whether authorities investigated or disciplined the alleged attackers."]},{"source_id":"SRC-61780dbd7918e1e3","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"UNFPA reported that ongoing fighting and recurrent natural disasters had displaced approximately 5.8 million people in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri by September 2023; overcrowded displacement sites increased risks for women and girls, including unintended pregnancies, obstetrical complications, maternal deaths, unmet basic needs, and gender-based violence.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes conditions in the DRC during Tshisekedi's presidency but does not attribute the displacement or disasters to him.","limitations":["This is contextual evidence of exposure and humanitarian need, not evidence of the ruler's policy response."]},{"source_id":"SRC-61780dbd7918e1e3","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"UNFPA reported that approximately 7.4 million people in eastern DRC needed health assistance in September 2023 while the health system was at a breaking point amid overlapping COVID-19, measles, polio, meningitis, and monkeypox outbreaks; yellow fever, cholera, and malaria were rising because of inadequate access to safe water and sanitation for displaced people.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The report describes national humanitarian and health conditions during Tshisekedi's presidency without attributing the failures to him personally.","limitations":["No government budget, implementation record, or causal attribution is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-61780dbd7918e1e3","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 16 June 2023, an IASC System-Wide Scale-Up was activated for eastern DRC to strengthen the humanitarian response.","question_ids":["6B.6","8B.9"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly within 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The action was taken by the inter-agency humanitarian system, not directly attributed to Tshisekedi's government.","limitations":["The supplied document does not show the extent of Congolese government initiation, funding, or implementation."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-70ad16640b036b07","SRC-6cd9142abf84caac","SRC-83c72d163edd72ac","SRC-f221560b27c54e29","SRC-a79030125ab3a8df","SRC-fe6234e02e79cbab","SRC-2d0ad835474905ae","SRC-bb8245c3a49efa61","SRC-7922ec65901a49a0"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents were landing pages or metadata records without the linked report contents, so their underlying findings could not be used as facts.","The Cambridge mining article's substantive evidence concerns periods before 2023, chiefly 2019-2022, and therefore was excluded as not materially within the requested 2023-2023 period.","No supplied document provides evidence concerning nuclear, biological, AI, cyber, or other existential-risk safeguards, so no 1B facts were emitted.","No supplied document provides sufficiently concrete 2023 evidence for most economic-wellbeing, integrity, or effectiveness lenses;
